title: camera_image
description: Answer to camera_image_get: the still image of the camera as Home Assistant delivered it, base64 encoded (RFC 4648, with padding, no line breaks). At most 2 MiB (2097152 bytes) of image data, so data_b64 has at most 2796204 characters; a larger image or another type is answered with control_error {ha_error}. content_type is one of the raster types listed; the app decodes the image, it never runs it. The whole message is at most 2 800 000 bytes (x-limits hub_image_message_max_bytes): clients accept WebSocket messages of that size.
